Houthis Allegedly Using Chinese Parts for Missile Development

Yemen's Houthi rebels are reportedly developing missiles using components sourced from China, according to reports. A missile based on an Iranian design could have a range of up to 1,200 miles. The Yemeni government has raised concerns with Beijing regarding the Houthis' alleged use of Chinese-made technology for weapons, with a Yemeni minister stating that discussions have taken place with China, described as a partner. This development occurs amid escalating regional tensions and the ongoing civil war in Yemen.
